exactness_certificate: At each elimination stage the updated entries are scaled minors of the original integer matrix; the Bareiss numerator is divisible exactly by the previous nonzero pivot. No tolerance or rounding occurs.

independent_algorithm_checks.random_integer_matrices: Bareiss compared against exact rational Gaussian elimination on bounded random matrices; mismatch 0.
independent_algorithm_checks.registry: Bareiss also compared with exact Leibniz determinant on every positive realizable exhaustive registry case.

input: Integer q x q matrix M=K^(r), q=|ACTIVE(T)|-1.
intermediate_values: Integers only; fraction-free updates avoid rational denominators. Magnitudes may grow with determinant/minor sizes; no unsupported bit bound is asserted.
pseudocode: A:=integer copy of M; sign:=+1; prev:=1.
For k=0,...,q-2, choose a row p>=k with A[p,k]!=0. If none exists, return 0.
If p!=k, swap rows p and k and set sign:=-sign.
pivot:=A[k,k]. For all i,j>k set A[i,j]:=(pivot*A[i,j]-A[i,k]*A[k,j])/prev using exact integer division.
Set A[i,k]:=0 for i>k; set prev:=pivot.
